purpose: Evaluate the fixed Treasury 10-Year auction-demand signal after Q019 contract validation, using a fresh symbol-disjoint asset universe and unchanged evidence standards.

event_source.fixed_signal: Signed change in bid-to-cover ratio versus immediately preceding 10-Year Note auction: positive=+1, negative=-1, unchanged=0.
event_source.point_in_time: Use the official record_date/publication date and act no earlier than the first XNYS session strictly after record_date.

trading_rule.exposure: On the first eligible XNYS session strictly after each event record_date, hold the event signal for that session only; outside event sessions exposure is zero.
trading_rule.mapping: +1 = equal-weight long across all 12 fixed assets; -1 = equal-weight short across all 12 fixed assets; 0 = flat.
trading_rule.sizing: Each active asset receives 1/12 of gross portfolio exposure with total gross exposure fixed at 1.0; no leverage.
trading_rule.overlap: Event sessions are distinct by calendar construction; if multiple mapped events fall on the same session, aggregate their fixed signals by arithmetic sum and use sign(sum), with zero producing flat exposure.
trading_rule.no_tuning: No threshold, holding period, asset, weighting, signal variant, horizon, leverage or parameter search.

authorization.authorization_condition: A formal performance execution requires successful fresh OHLCV coverage on the fixed universe, a frozen snapshot fingerprint, and an explicit immutable execution authorization recorded before performance computation.

interpretation: Q020 is a fixed-rule performance design only. Passing Q019 source/PIT coverage does not imply predictive value or profitability.
